records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three months ended March 31, 2022, we generated $179.0 million in total revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the three months ended March 31, 2022 was: cloud subscriptions 21%; software license 5%; maintenance 20%; services 50%; and hardware 4%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our international revenue was approximately $56.5 million for the three months ended March 31, 2022, which represents approximately 32% our total revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our R&D expenses were $27.5 million for the three months ended March 31, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2022, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $31.8 million.
